text:
ana: Quick company-wide note about Private/on-prem telemetry and audit logs. We're changing policy to make remote telemetry opt-in for Private (appliance/VPC) deployments and adding per-tenant log retention controls. Please read and flag any legal or customer-facing concerns.

 tom: Summary: starting next release, the default for Private installs will be NO telemetry by default. Customers can opt in to send anonymous runtime metrics to our hosted control plane for assisted troubleshooting and feature telemetry. Well provide a local-only mode and an opt-in remote mode.

 laura: Legal: this change is to align with stricter customer privacy/compliance requirements. Any telemetry that could contain customer data must be redacted client-side. We'll prepare an approved privacy blurb and an opt-in consent template for contracts.

 sam: Security: telemetry will be limited to non-PHI runtime metrics, anonymized hashes for error signatures, and optional stack traces only if customer enables "send-debug-info". For air-gapped installs remote telemetry is disabled; we provide downloadable diagnostics instead.

 maria: CS: we need a customer-facing FAQ ASAP. Customers will ask: does opt-in mean we can still get remote help? Answer: yes, with explicit consent and a temporary grant window. We'll offer a guided diagnostics session for customers who refuse remote telemetry.

 tom: Implementation notes for ops/engineers: new config knobs in appliance config.yaml:

 ```yaml
 telemetry:
   enabled: false    # default for new installs
   mode: "local"    # values: local | remote | disabled
   send_debug_info: false
 retention:
   audit_logs_days: 30   # per-tenant default, adjustable
 ```

 tom: We will ship a migration script to toggle existing customers to the new defaults and notify them. For customers who previously had telemetry enabled, we will contact them with an opt-in request and a 30-day window before changing behavior.

 laura: Action: legal will draft the consent language and update the privacy policy excerpt. ETA: 4 business days.

 sam: Ops/security action: ensure server-side telemetry endpoints reject payloads that fail client-side redaction rules and add an automated scanner to flag PII-like patterns before persisting.

 maria: CS action: create the FAQ and a short email template for outreach. Also prepare a support playbook for guided diagnostics (how to run export bundles).

 deploy-bot: "policy: telemetry-opt-in rollout announced by ana at 2026-04-25T18:00Z"

 ana: Timeline: announcement now, docs + FAQ next week, opt-in outreach for current customers starts in 30 days. Internal walkthrough on the change Thurs 10:00 PT  invite will be sent. If you need to be in the early pilot for the new retention controls, reply here. :eyes:
